job.purpose: SE/NE core-only VM bank (H-NETLIST d4f 1b42352f8: q1 master with dq, rq1/rq2, wq1 absent) native closure for the vmb_SE/NE0..7 hoist.
job.structural_change: SE/NE bank = hfd_vms_bank_native_q1_core_pr (literal input pin flops in RTL; view == RTL) on recipe 4 (hold_budget die, no pads).
